question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word to fill in the blank in the sentence.

Elaborate

A/an _________ water clock depicting zodiac signs is present in the city museum.
solution:
The correct answer is "**intricate**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Elaborate**" is used to denote an object, plan, or piece of work that is detailed and complicated in design or planning. (विस्तृत) 

 
 
• **Example**- The building is known for its elaborate architecture.
 
 
 
• "**Intricate**" denotes that something is very complicated or detailed. (जटिल)
 
 
• **Example**- The intricate design of the carpet amazed the visitors.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is similar in meaning to the given word is "intricate".

Therefore, the correct answer is '**option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let's have a look at the meanings of the remaining options.
 
• "**Beautiful**" signifies pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically. (सुंदर)
 
• "**Resonant**" denotes (of sound) deep, clear, and continuing to sound or ring. (गूंजदार)
 
• "**Divulging**" implies making (private or sensitive) information known. (खुलासा करना)
